# exa Provider

Manages [Exa](https://exa.ai) API keys through the [Team Management API](https://exa.ai/docs/reference/team-management/create-api-key). Exa enables that API per team: ask support@exa.ai for access and a service key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "exa" {
  # The team's Exa service key. Defaults to the EXA_SERVICE_KEY environment variable.
  # api_key = var.exa_service_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The team's Exa service key, sent as `x-api-key` to the Team Management API. Defaults to the `EXA_SERVICE_KEY` environment variable.
